checks: Standalone queued files and settings survive owner navigation; no default storage is silently substituted; submitted settings remain frozen while the next draft changes. Two real native uploads finish with distinct images and authenticated thumbnails.

Album Upload enters the full page with albumId and exact returnTo; the source album is preselected by server data. A rejected upload keeps its bytes and settings, survives navigation, and retries with the frozen album relation.

A real background retry refreshes the current album count and actual cover without reopening or reloading the list. Completed upload provides an explicit return to its original album. The independent standalone draft is untouched.

Album card right click, Shift+F10 and touch overflow expose the same four actions; Escape restores the source, and editing opens the real form. Return is aligned with the title, with four compact 44px actions in the separate toolbar.
The existing picker shows all three real uploaded thumbnails and disables the already-added image.
limitations: Chromium emulation, not physical mobile hardware. Real local uploads are exercised; remote S3 transport is unchanged and not retested by this suite.

checks: Only selected images expose the toolbar action menu; public/no-album selection hides redundant public/remove actions. Right-click contains only five common actions and Escape restores card focus.
Manage selection contains thumbnails and selection commands; select-current keeps it open, Escape returns focus, and clear removes the selection without a business menu.

Private-only selection hides private; mixed selection exposes both choices. The confirmed public mutation sends only the one private ID, retains both matching selections and refreshes menu eligibility from real metadata.

Library removal requires an explicitly chosen target and leaves the other album intact. Album-context removal has no target list, freezes only the current album, removes its out-of-query selection and never deletes the image.
Real two-image trash and restore each require one confirmation, update the database, clear resolved selection and finish with a toast, without a success dialog.
Explicit membership reads disable existing images; two selected images survive distinct searches and page 1 → page 2.
A rejected real command preserves both selected IDs, the search and the current page; the album remains unchanged.

After a real join commits but its response is lost, the picker only reads back once, creates no duplicate join, closes in the same album, restores focus and refreshes its real count/automatic-cover identity.

A real first-image join plus a second-image failure followed by a detail HTTP 500 keeps the picker mounted, the failed image selected and the refresh error visible; explicit retry adds only the retained failure and refreshes the real count.
A membership-read failure hides selectable choices and remains actionable; retry restores the actual existing-member badge, and Escape restores the Add Images trigger.
